decision: Music: PhonkFlux 'TRANSFORMATION' (TikTok CML 7634998460610005008), video t0 = track 10.812; impact on the drop at 16.227 (video 5.415, f162); text 18.023, logo 19.827

decision: v0 delivered: 12.2 s, -14.0 LUFS, peak -3.8 dBFS, safe-zone text boxes OK, cuts within half a frame of the measured hits

decision: v0.2 slow-reader timing: s6 feather fall at half speed (sim stepped 0.5 frame per video frame from f216), 3.6 s under BLACK FRIDAY SALE (SALE readable ~2.6 s before the cut); logo moved to the hit at 21.630 (f324), URL at f330 held 2.6 s + 0.4 s fade; 14.0 s total

decision: OSRS-inspired look test: build_turkey_osrs (few-poly Gouraud-smooth, muted colours, dot eyes, 7 tail slabs), rendered low-res and upscaled nearest; scene.py TURKEY_STYLE=osrs swaps it in; text mock: 'WISHING OUR DRIVERS A' (Unbounded 500) + HAPPY / THANKSGIVING (Akira), BLACK / FRIDAY / SALE + 'UNTIL (END DATE)' placeholder
why: owner asked to see a retro-MMO turkey and new copy; style homage only (no Jagex assets/logo/font, game not named in the ad); BF end date is not set anywhere (PRICES.md: no dates on screen), so a visible placeholder instead of inventing one

decision: Pending for the next version: tighten the text timing to the revised minimum (1.8 s for 1-3 words, +0.3 s/extra word; 2.2 s prices) - e.g. the feather slow-mo nearer 1 bar; Thanksgiving greeting (6 words) needs >= 2.7 s
why: owner via parent: holds 'a bit too slow'; apply only when the video changes for another reason, no timing-only version

decision: Declined using Animal Crossing's Franklin (or a lookalike); offered our original turkey with a generic chef kit (white toque + wooden spoon, add_chef_kit in turkey.py), natural brown colours kept
why: Nintendo-owned character in a commercial ad = IP infringement; brief forbids trademarked characters
